da2_qualifications_filter_list_mechanics.workflow: In DA2 Query Builder, highlight any coded field in the left tree and click the bottom-right '->' button (Add to Qualifications) or drag the field into the Qualifications pane. DA2 automatically sets the qualification type dropdown to 'Filter List' and displays '[Modify Filter List...]'. Clicking 'Modify Filter List...' opens the 'Select Values for <Field>' modal displaying all active CODE_VALUE display strings configured in the Millennium domain.

modal_controls.available_values_list: Left-hand list box showing all candidate display values (sorted alphabetically, starting with Null).
modal_controls.selected_values_list: Right-hand list box showing values moved via 'Move >' or 'Move All >>'.
modal_controls.filter_values_search_box: Substring/prefix search box ('Filter values:') essential for high-cardinality fields like CE Event, Order Mnemonic, or Diag ICD Code.
modal_controls.show_inactive_values_checkbox: Reveals historical/inactive CODE_VALUE rows (ACTIVE_IND = 0) needed for multi-year retrospective queries.
modal_controls.include_vs_exclude_buttons: 'Include' emits IN (...) in the generated EJS SQL; 'Exclude' emits NOT IN (...).

da2_qualifications_filter_list_mechanics.why_filter_list_values_matter: Many DA2 fields have similar names (e.g., Enc Type vs EncType Class vs Enc Med Service; Pay Trans Type vs Pay Trans Sub Type vs Pay Trans Reason; Adj Trans Sub Type vs Adj Trans Reason; CE Event vs DTA Mnemonic vs Order Mnemonic). Knowing the exact enumerated values inside each field's Qualification Filter List is the definitive way to classify which field holds a requested clinical or financial concept.

Stores administrative/clinical sex (Code Set 57). Birth sex is stored in 'Per Pat Birth Sex' (PERSON_PATIENT.BIRTH_SEX_CD).

Primary race is in 'Person Race' (PERSON.RACE_CD, Code Set 282). Multi-race granular values are stored in 'Person Code Value Relation' (PERSON_CODE_VALUE_R, 'Per Code R Code Value' where Code Set = 282).
OMB Hispanic/Latino ethnicity classification (Code Set 27), distinct from 'Person Race' (Code Set 282).
Patient marital status (Code Set 38, FHIR Patient.maritalStatus).
When only the primary MRN or SSN is needed without 1-to-many join duplication, prefer 'Person Functions' -> 'Person MRN' or 'Person SSN' (No Join Required).
When only the patient's Home Address is needed, prefer 'Person Functions' -> 'Hm Addr Street 1', 'Hm Addr City', 'Hm Addr State', 'Hm Addr Zip' (No Join Required) to avoid row multiplication.
When only the Home Phone is needed, prefer 'Person Functions' -> 'Hm Phn Number' (No Join Required).
Granular encounter visit type (Code Set 71). For broad inpatient vs outpatient grouping, filter on 'EncType Class' (ENCOUNTER.ENCNTR_TYPE_CLASS_CD, Code Set 69).
High-level encounter class roll-up (Code Set 69). Use 'Enc Type' (Code Set 71) when distinguishing Inpatient Rehab vs Acute Inpatient or Outpatient PT vs Outpatient OT.

ce_event_powerchart_taxonomy.estimated_domain_cardinality: 10,000 to 60,000+ active CODE_VALUE rows per Millennium domain
ce_event_powerchart_taxonomy.why_ce_event_is_unique: In Cerner Millennium PowerChart, nearly every clinical observation — PowerForm discrete fields, InteractiveView (iView) flowsheet rows, IRF-PAI Section GG & FIM functional scores, PT/OT/SLP therapy treatment minutes, vital signs, nursing risk assessments (Morse Fall, Braden, Pain, GCS, NIHSS, PHQ-9), General Lab/Microbiology/Point-of-Care test results, Dynamic Documentation PowerNotes, and scanned CPDI documents — is stored in CLINICAL_EVENT and identified by 'CE Event' (CLINICAL_EVENT.EVENT_CD, Code Set 72). Knowing the exact PowerChart 'CE Event' display vocabulary and how it maps to Event Sets (Code Set 93) and Discrete Task Assays (Code Set 14003) is mandatory for translating clinical requests into working DA2/CCL queries.

discovery_and_filtering_strategies.name: DA2 Qualification Filter List Substring Search
discovery_and_filtering_strategies.description: Drag 'CE Event' into Qualifications -> click 'Modify Filter List...' -> type clinical keywords (e.g., 'GG0130', 'GG0170', 'FIM', 'PT ', 'OT ', 'SLP ', 'Minutes', 'Morse', 'Braden', 'Pain', 'Systolic', 'Glucose', 'Discharge Summary') into 'Filter values:' to locate exact site display names.

discovery_and_filtering_strategies.name: Event Set Hierarchy (Code Set 93 -> V500_EVENT_SET_EXPLODE -> Code Set 72)
discovery_and_filtering_strategies.description: Use V500_EVENT_SET_CANON and V500_EVENT_SET_CODE (MD_D_EVENT_SET_HIERARCHY / MD_D_EVENT_SET_SEARCH) rooted at 'ALL OCF EVENT SETS' -> 'ALL SPECIALTY SECTIONS' / 'ALL RESULT SECTIONS' and join V500_EVENT_SET_EXPLODE on EVENT_SET_CD to capture all child EVENT_CD values without brittle string lists.

discovery_and_filtering_strategies.name: Discrete Task Assay (DTA, Code Set 14003) & PowerForm Definition Bridge
discovery_and_filtering_strategies.description: In DA2 'CWC Encounter' -> 'Clinical Event' -> 'Discrete Task Assay' ('DTA Mnemonic', 'DTA Description', 'DTA Activity Type'), or in CCL via DCP_FORMS_REF -> DCP_FORMS_DEF -> DCP_SECTION_REF -> DCP_INPUT_REF -> DISCRETE_TASK_ASSAY.EVENT_CD, resolve the exact EVENT_CD backing any PowerForm or iView band.
